## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first (per AGENTS.md). Dispositions:
- **Spec-inline ADR-0213 (OQ-170)** — kernel signer key custody is open
  and "blocking for Stage 2 signing": honored by the trait seam
  (ADR-0267 D6) — the ledger consumes `AuditSigner`/`AuditKeyResolver`,
  custody stays in `kernel_use(LedgerSigning)`; embed runs declare no
  `signer_key_ids` until custody lands → **DF-S2.5-1 opened**.
- **DF-S2.3-1 / DF-S2.4-1** — inspected; producer-side call sites are
  the named consumers' (same discipline applies to S2.5's reciprocal
  anchor producers → **DF-S2.5-2 opened**).
- **Opened:** DF-S2.5-1 (custody wiring + cadence/final emission at the
  embed layer + `request_redaction` op), DF-S2.5-2 (I-A6 reciprocal
  anchors' producer rows — `parent_head_at_spawn`/`parent_anchor`/
  `child_head`, owned by the subagent-lifecycle ticket).

## Requirements

The ticket stamps **R-2.8.6** and gates on **AC-R-2.8.6-{1,2} +
removability(0…3)** (deterministic) + the universal phase-gate AC.

| id | deliverable |
|---|---|
| compact-range tree heads | `hh-ledger/src/tree.rs` — RFC-6962-style leaf/node hashing over event hashes, deterministic empty head, `mth`/`mth_prefix`, `CompactRange` frontier maintained per run (`RunState.tree`, pushed at commit + rebuilt at load — derived, never load-bearing) |
| signed `security.audit.checkpoint` | `Store::checkpoint(run, lease, kind, signer)` — claim binds `tree_size == own seq`, `tree_head` (covered MTH), `chain_hash`, `idp` self-id, `prev_checkpoint` link, `cross_run_anchors` (forked/spawned children in range), `signatures[]`; `hmac-sha256` construction (ADR-0267 D1); `final` lands after `finished`, covers it, idempotent; consistency-verified-extension gate ⇒ `InconsistentHead` (D4) |
| `prove_*`/`verify_*` | `prove_inclusion`/`prove_consistency` (logarithmic, JSON round-trip, bound to size+head); `verify_run(run, from, to, keys)` — byte-exact WAL replay + the checkpoint layer: claim re-derivation (`CheckpointInvalid`), unsubstantiable head (`ForkEquivocation`), `SigMissing`/`BadSignature`, `from`/`to` watermarks ⇒ `Truncate` (D7), manifest lineage re-verify; `Store::verify` = `verify_run` with the installed resolver |
| cross-run anchors | claim-listed anchors recomputed against the named run's durable prefix (`ForkEquivocation` on contradiction; `unresolvable` when the run is not held — honest, surfaced by `audit_view`); manifest `forked_from`/`continued_from`/`parent_run_id` resolved at view + verify |
| auditor subscription | `Auditor` — own leaf fold + compact range + held heads + observed claims; `observe` re-checks seq density (`Gap`), hash recomputation (`Equivocation`), run identity and signed claims; `Store::audit_with` feeds the durable prefix — no store access inside the auditor (D8) |
| `lifecycle.ledger.gc` | `Store::gc(run, lease, addresses, policy_ref, tier, retained_until)` — durable record first, then delete, then tombstone; `Pinned` on live references; `audit_view` accounts `content_refs.gc[]` |
| redaction/completeness | `Store::redact` — `approval` (principal+) / `policy_rule` (kernel) bases, `IllegitimateEndorsement` otherwise; `Address` + `Field{event_id, field}` targets; `audit_fields` members ⇒ `NotRedactable` (AC-R-2.8.6-2); tombstones persisted via load-time reconstruction from the durable rows (D5 — no second store) |
| ops surface | `audit_view`/`verify`/`prove_inclusion`/`prove_consistency` implemented stable; `verify` returns `{verdict, at_seq, kind}` as data; `request_redaction` stays staged-experimental (DF-S2.5-1); drift artifacts regenerated |
| tamper verdicts | extended `TamperedKind`: `truncate`, `checkpoint_invalid`, `sig_missing`, `bad_signature`, `fork_equivocation` beside the existing battery |

## AC matrix

| AC | evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-R-2.8.6-1 (verify detects every tamper class) | `audit_checkpoints.rs::tamper_battery` — edited content ⇒ `content_modified`; deleted tail + caller watermark ⇒ `truncate` (prefix alone still verifies — D7); reordered event rows ⇒ `reordered`; late insert ⇒ `duplicate_seq`; member rename ⇒ `noncanonical_bytes`; `forked_signed_head_is_fork_equivocation` ⇒ `fork_equivocation` (a coherently re-signed claim over a head the log cannot substantiate); `bad_signature_detected` ⇒ `bad_signature`; `finished_signed_run_without_final_is_truncated` ⇒ `truncate`; the pre-existing battery (seq_gap/chain_broken/dangling_parent/producer/duplicate_event_id) unchanged-green in `acceptance.rs` |
| AC-R-2.8.6-2 (redaction/GC leave the chain valid; audit fields never redactable) | `redact_content_refs_only_audit_fields_never` — `lifecycle.ledger.redacted` durable, blob tombstoned `redacted`, `audit_fields` member refused `NotRedactable`, weak endorser `IllegitimateEndorsement`, `verify` clean after; `gc_writes_durable_record_then_deletes_and_tombstones` — `lifecycle.ledger.gc` durable before delete, `Missing{gc}` after, tombstone survives reopen, `verify` clean; `gc_refuses_pinned_and_malformed` — `Pinned` on another run's `refs`, `SchemaViolation` on a non-idp id |
| signed checkpoints + proofs + anchors + auditor | `checkpoint_lands_signed_covers_the_durable_prefix`, `checkpoint_chain_links_prev_claim`, `final_checkpoint_covers_finished_and_is_idempotent`, `checkpoint_refuses_without_declared_key_or_signer` (`SignerUnavailable`), `inclusion_proof_roundtrips_and_rejects_wrong_claims`, `consistency_proof_roundtrips_and_rejects_forks`, `auditor_holds_independent_heads`, `auditor_detects_gap_and_equivocation`, `audit_view_reports_checkpoints_completeness_and_tombstones` (verified status, `checkpoints_ok`, `content_refs.gc[]` accounted) |
| ≥100-run corpus | `corpus_100_runs_verify_and_prove` — 100 signed runs, each verify_run + inclusion + consistency proof green |

### Self-review

- The ledger is the only store: `audit_view` folds the durable prefix;
  tombstones are *derived* from durable `redacted`/`gc` rows at load —
  no shadow index, no second write path (ADR-0066 D1).
- Signing never fabricates: the kernel signs only a head it recomputed
  and proved an append-only extension of the held claim
  (`InconsistentHead`); signatures report `unverified` without a
  resolver, never `verified`.
- `final` covers `finished` by construction (`tree_size == own seq`),
  lands once, and closes the signed stream — a finished run with
  declared signers and no final is `truncate`, not silently clean.
- No secret material anywhere: `AuditSigner` hands the ledger a
  signature over a preimage; key bytes live behind the resolver seam
  (DF-S2.5-1 wires `kernel_use`); tests use throwaway `FixedSigner`
  bytes, nothing persisted.
- GC/redact are durable-before-delete and pin-checked; `audit_fields`
  members refuse unconditionally (AC-R-2.8.6-2); tombstone reasons
  survive restart.
- `verify` never panics on a forged file: every malformed row, torn
  tail, or non-canonical byte is a typed verdict.
- Deviations from the phantom-overlay incident: `store.rs` was patched
  via `python3` against the real filesystem after the file-view overlay
  diverged; the splice artifacts (`_audit_ops.inc`, `_s25_patch.py`)
  were removed after inlining; no probe markers remain (`grep` clean).

### Evidence report

- **AC-R-2.8.6-1 executable** — the tamper battery covers all ten
  verdict kinds; the checkpoint layer re-derives every claim member;
  fork-equivalence and signature failures are typed.
- **AC-R-2.8.6-2 executable** — redact/gc leave the chain valid with
  durable tombstones; audit fields are never redactable; pinned
  addresses refuse.
- **removability(0…3)** — the script green; no new feature surface.
- **universal phase gate** — workspace tests/clippy/fmt/drift/
  build-memory all green.
